{{Quote|The fighting's got to stop! There's good folk dying out there, all because those CorSec boneheads don't know when to quit. Used to wear the uniform myself once, back when it still meant something. Now CorSec's just a bunch of trigger-happy hooligans with more ammo than common sense. '''Raddus Venn''' was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] (CorSec) at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]]. At the start of the [[Battle of Corellia]], Raddus was one of the few CorSec officers to collaborate with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and used his effort to recruit an Imperial hero to track down his former companions that deserted and helped the rebellion.

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Former officer. I joined CorSec to uphold the law. The Empire's the law here now. [...] Please, try to keep the fighting off the streets if you can. Don't want any civilians getting caught in the cross fire.|Raddus Venn, to an Imperial|<ref name="CorSec Crackdown" />}}
Raddus Venn became disillusioned with his colleagues in the [[Corellian Security Force]], who he thought were no more than criminals with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] who only wanted to shoot. Thus, the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] enlisted the help of a Sith Empire-aligned individual to remove CorSec forces from the streets.
